decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Amended drawings 1ARevA and 2ARevA Received 18th November 2005)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Any manufacturing activity on the site shall remain ancillary to the lawful use as a builders' yard and no industrial activities shall take place anywhere on the site except inside the building, and any ancillary joinery and assembly activities shall only be carried out in the equipment, joinery and assembly room identified on the submitted plan.

Condition : 5 - The use herby permitted shall not be carried on outside the hours of 07.30 to 18.30 Monday to Friday, 08.00 to 12.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays.
Condition : 6 - Hours of construction - 08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday, 09.00 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none on Sundays and public holidays.
Condition : 7 - The windows formed in the east elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 8 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 10 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 11 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the use hereby permitted is commenced or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 13 - Full details and specifications of the measures, including details of the proposed foundations of the building, to be taken to protect the adjoining Holly Tree (the roots of which enter the application site on the southern boundary) from damage, before or during the course of development, shall be received and approved in writing by the local planning authority prior to the commencement of the works.
Condition : 14 - No part of the building shall exceed 3m in height.
description: Extension of implementation timescales for planning permission 00195/B/P3 dated 24.11.05 for 'Rebuilding of fire damaged yard incorporating office, storage area, ancillary joinery assembly area and parking area.'
